feeds.title: Virutal Mom Collective Blog
feeds.description: The VMC Blog is run by the Victoria Marie Children's Boutique in Miami, Florida. Their blog features fashion tips and product reviews for children's clothing and accessories. The mission of the VMC Blog is to provide parents with the latest trends in children's fashion and help them make informed purchasing decisions.

feeds.title: Blame it on Mei
feeds.description: Blame it on Mei is a blog run by a Miami-based mom, covering topics such as fashion, beauty, and travel. Their blog features personal stories, product reviews, and travel guides. The mission of Blame it on Mei is to inspire and empower women to embrace their unique sense of style and live their best lives.

feeds.title: Cleverly Me
feeds.description: Cleverly Me is a blog run by a Miami-based mom, covering topics such as parenting, food, and travel. Their blog features personal stories, product reviews, and recipes. The mission of Cleverly Me is to provide a community for moms to share their experiences and inspire each other to live their best lives.

feeds.title: Miami Style Mom
feeds.description: Miami Style Mom is a blog run by a Miami-based mom, covering topics such as fashion, beauty, and motherhood. Their blog features personal stories, product reviews, and style tips for moms. The mission of Miami Style Mom is to help moms feel confident and stylish while juggling the demands of motherhood.

feeds.title: Aline Lowry
feeds.description: Aline gives travel tips and ideas through her blogs and she also gives details of hotels, cruises and places to visit. Aline truly believes that style comes from the inside of each one of us. You don't have to break the bank to be stylish.

feeds.title: Casita Rodriguez
feeds.description: Bambina Diaries is a blog run by a Miami-based mom, covering topics such as motherhood, travel, and style. Their blog features personal stories, product reviews, and tips for navigating motherhood. The mission of Bambina Diaries is to inspire and empower moms to embrace their individuality and pursue their passions.

feeds.title: Cool Moms Cool Tips
feeds.description: Welcome to the Cool Moms Cool Tips! My name is Taty, I'm originally from South America, I am a proud Miami resident! I like to think that I am fostering a tireless wonder to discover the world while we bridge across cultures via food, travel, exploring, and education, to name a few. All the while looking for great finds that help keep families cool, chill, and zen. Subscribe to keep up with the latest from this blog.

feeds.title: A Raad Story
feeds.description: South Florida Parenting blog that shines light on the joys of pregnancy, postpartum, and motherhood. Offering practical tips on motherhood journey and life with little ones from a Broward mom. A Raad Story helps build up and encourage the everyday woman to have a positive outlook in her daily life by offering an optimistic perspective of our daily adventures as a new loving family.
